data.body: Session 2026-05-12: Added two new structural tests to test-merge-to-main-pr-resume-and-stale.sh (test_phase_merge_reuses_existing_draft_pr and test_phase_resolve_threads_local_escalation_on_missing_llm_cmd) as part of fixing 1fcc-5fe2. These tests grep for specific bash commands in merge-to-main-pr.sh, which adds to the source-grepping pattern this ticket is tracking. The structural test count continues to grow — this ticket remains relevant.
